EnduranceToggle.Name: Endurance Toggle
EnduranceToggle.Hint: Toggles the automation of the Endurance system.

SoulToggle.Name: Soul Toggle
SoulToggle.Hint: Toggles the automation of the Soul system.

SoulLongRest.Name: Soul Long Rest Reset
SoulLongRest.Hint: When on, an actor's Soul resets to full when they take a long rest.

ChatMessages.Name: Toggle Chat Messages
ChatMessages.Hint: Toggles messages in chat for Soul and Endurance.

Meters.Name: Toggle Sheet Meters
Meters.Hint: Shows the Endurance and Soul meters on Tidy5e character sheets.

HideMessages.Name: Hide Messages Toggle
HideMessages.Hint: When on, non-GM players only see chat rows for actors they own. Empty sections and entire messages collapse automatically.

SoulItemBlacklist.Name: Soul Item Blacklist
SoulItemBlacklist.Hint: Comma-separated list of item names that should not generate Soul.

SoulSectionBlacklist.Name: Soul Section Blacklist
SoulSectionBlacklist.Hint: Comma-separated list of Tidy5e sections that should not generate Soul.

MeterColor.Name: {label} Meter Color
MeterColor.Hint: Override the {label} meter colour. Leave blank to use the Tidy theme default.

Tracker.Name: Combat Tracker Endurance
Tracker.Hint: Shows each combatant's Endurance (and weaknesses) on the combat tracker.

TrackerVisibility.Name: Combat Tracker Endurance Visibility
TrackerVisibility.Hint: What players see for combatants they are not at least an Observer of. The GM and owners/observers always see everything.
TrackerVisibility.Bar: Bar only: no numbers or weaknesses

BreakFx.Name: Endurance Break Effects
BreakFx.Hint: Plays a floating "BREAK!" text, sound and screen shake when Endurance breaks. Uses Sequencer (if active) so everyone viewing the scene sees it.

BreakFxSound.Name: Endurance Break Sound
BreakFxSound.Hint: Sound played on a break. Leave blank for no sound.

BreakFxFile.Name: Endurance Break Animation
BreakFxFile.Hint: Optional animation file (e.g. a JB2A .webm) played on the broken token. Requires Sequencer. Leave blank for none.

BreakFxShake.Name: Endurance Break Screen Shake
BreakFxShake.Hint: Briefly shakes the screen of everyone viewing the scene on a break. Requires Sequencer.

EnduranceBreakItems.Name: Endurance Break Items
EnduranceBreakItems.Label: Configure
EnduranceBreakItems.Hint: Configure which item UUID fires the synthetic damage roll for each damage type when Endurance breaks.

Values.Name: Endurance & Soul Values
Values.Label: Configure
Values.Hint: How much Endurance each kind of hit removes and how much Soul is gained. Individual items can override these from their sheet header menu (Homebrew Overrides).

BreakFx.Name: Endurance Break Effects
BreakFx.Label: Configure
BreakFx.Hint: The floating "BREAK!" text, sound, animation and screen shake played when Endurance breaks.

SoulRules.Name: Soul Rules
SoulRules.Label: Configure
SoulRules.Hint: Long-rest reset and the item / section blacklists that never generate Soul.

Tracker.Name: Combat Tracker
Tracker.Label: Configure
Tracker.Hint: Endurance bars on the combat tracker and what players can see of them.

Chat.Name: Chat Cards
Chat.Label: Configure
Chat.Hint: Whether Endurance/Soul results are posted to chat, and what players see of them.

Reload.Name: Reload Everyone
Reload.Label: Reload
Reload.Hint: Reloads every connected client (players too), e.g. after updating the module. You can also bind a key to it under Configure Controls.

BreakConfig.Title: Endurance Break Items
BreakConfig.Hint: Map each damage type to the item UUID used for synthetic rolls when Endurance breaks. Leave blank to skip that damage type.

Chat.NoToken: {name} has no token on the current scene.

ValuesConfig.Title: Endurance & Soul Values
ValuesConfig.Hint: Blank fields fall back to the default shown in grey. Item overrides (sheet header menu → Homebrew Overrides) take priority over these.

Overrides.Title: Homebrew Overrides: {name}
Overrides.Hint: Leave a field blank to use the world value from Endurance & Soul Values.

enduranceReduction.Name: Endurance damage
enduranceReduction.Hint: Endurance removed per weakness hit (crit bonus still applies; 0 = never). World value: {value}.

soulGainPerTarget.Name: Soul gain per hit target
soulGainPerTarget.Hint: Soul the attacker gains per target hit. World values: {attack} (attack), {aoe} (AoE).

ignoreWeakness.Name: Ignore weaknesses
ignoreWeakness.Hint: Reduce Endurance on any hit, not just weakness hits, unless the target resists or is immune to every damage type of the hit.

bypassResistance.Name: Also bypass resistance & immunity
bypassResistance.Hint: Requires "Ignore weaknesses". Reduce Endurance on any hit, even through resistance or immunity.

Undo.Tooltip: Revert this card: Endurance/Soul changes, broken effects, the break damage roll (HP, its chat card and any effects it applied) and hit tracking. The original attack's HP damage is not reverted.
Undo.Failed: Homebrew Mechanics: undo failed, see the console.
Undo.ApplyTooltip: Re-apply the changes from this card (in case the undo was an accident).
Undo.Partial: Homebrew Mechanics: done, but {count} step(s) were skipped (usually something another module had already removed). See the console.

Tracker.BrokenHint: Broken until the start of its next turn.

Reload.Title: Reload Everyone?
Reload.Body: This reloads Foundry for every connected user, including you.
Reload.GMOnly: Only the GM can reload everyone.
